name: project-context
description: Injects this repo's purpose, ideas, and repo-specific rules into the single-source AI config, then fans them into every agentic file. Interviews the operator using ai/context/questions.json, writes the answers into ai/shared/ (00-project.md, 05-features.md, 12-repo-rules.md), and runs `pnpm run ai:sync`. Use once after init to teach a fresh clone about itself. NOT readonly — it must write the source files. To revise later, use the update-project-context skill.
